_comment: Godot 4: one .glb per asset. Godot builds its own LODs on import, so generated LODs stay out. Name-colonly / Name-convcolonly meshes are collision only and ride in Name's file; -col / -convcol meshes are regular assets

naming.description: PascalCase, optionally with a Godot import hint (-col, -convcol, -occ...)
